query:
WITH moved AS (
                         UPDATE log_file SET indexed_at =
                             CASE WHEN log_ts > $1 THEN NULL ELSE now() END
                         WHERE (indexed_at = 'epoch' AND log_ts > $1)
                            OR (indexed_at IS NULL AND log_ts <= $1) RETURNING 1)
                     SELECT count(*) AS "n!" FROM moved
